schema.units: pixels in the 1080x1080 reference frame (origin top-left, y down) unless noted; frame = 0-based index of sequential cv2 reads, t = frame/30 s
schema.pose_convention: anchor = mouth tip of the bottle = centre of the top edge of the lip ring. angle = long-axis angle in degrees, 0 = upright neck-up, positive = clockwise on screen. A point p of the upright art (x right, y down, origin = anchor, body toward +y) is drawn at anchor + scale * R(angle) p with R = [[cos,-sin],[sin,cos]].
schema.bottles.<name>.track: [frame, anchor_x, anchor_y, angle_deg, scale, rmse, visible_fraction, centre_x, centre_y]; centre = body centroid (= anchor + R(angle) * template.centroid_from_anchor_upright), also the measured rotation pivot; rmse = masked colour RMS difference template vs frame in 0-255 units (boil + interpolation keep it ~30-38; ~17-20 on frames with the template boil phase); visible_fraction = share of the bottle silhouette inside the frame (the bottle enters/leaves through the left edge). scale was fixed at 1.0 after the aniso check found no change.
schema.bottles.<name>.choreography: phase frame ranges [first,last] derived from the track: slide_in, tilt_in (angle rising to >110), pour_angle_over_110, tilt_out, slide_out; pour_extrema = local max/min of the pour rocking angle [kind, frame, angle].
schema.bottles.<name>.rotation_pivot_*: [frame, px, py]: instantaneous centre of rotation between frame and frame+1 in upright-art coordinates relative to the anchor (only pairs with >=2 deg rotation).
schema.bottles.<name>.pour_highpass_jitter_std: std of (value - 5-frame moving average) during the pour, px / deg: measures frame-to-frame noise (line boil) in the track.
schema.bottles.<name>.aniso_check: [frame, sx_across, sy_along, rmse_at_track_pose, rmse_best] best anisotropic scale in {0.96..1.04}; (1,1) almost always = no squash/stretch.
schema.bottles.<name>.template: source frame of the template art, base (empty) frame, residual tilt of the bottle in the source frame (the art was derotated by it), body-centroid position relative to the anchor in upright art.
schema.streams.<name>.frames.<frame>.stream: attached (bool: band starts at the mouth), length (px along centre line), raw_extension_px (part traced on raw ink edges below the new-pixel band, i.e. inside liquid/over ice), band_end [x,y] (end of the new-pixel band = where the stream meets the liquid surface or an ice cube), pts = 12 points from mouth (or detached top) to end: [x, y, mask_width, outer_width, core_width, ink_thickness]; mask_width = width of the closed new-pixel band (approx.), outer_width = ink outer edge to outer edge from the raw cross-section, core_width = fill between the two ink lines, ink_thickness = mean of both sides; the 3 last are null at the two end points or where the profile was ambiguous.
schema.streams.<name>.frames.<frame>.drops: [x, y, radius, colour_hex, kind, score]; kind drop = solid dark dot (campari/vermouth: distance-transform peak, radius = DT+0.5, score = DT), bubble = small ink ring (gin: ring correlation, score = NCC). Only within 75 px of the stream surface entry and not lower than 8 px below it.
schema.streams.<name>.cross_section: medians over all measured cross-sections: outer/core width, ink thickness, ink/fill/highlight colour; highlight_pos_in_core = position of the brightest core pixel measured from the screen-right ink line toward the screen-left one (0..1).
schema.art.<name>: upright-art measurements, origin = anchor (mouth tip), +y toward the base. width_profile_every_2px = [y, x_left, x_right] of the silhouette outer edge (includes the fill that sticks out left of the outline); outline_polygon = simplified outer contour; probe = direct pixel reads: label_outer_box (ink border included), body_ink_outer_x (outer edge of the outline ink on body rows), body_fill_x (fill colour extent on the same rows).

gin.origin_note: art px, origin = mouth tip (top centre of lip ring), +y toward the base, upright

campari.origin_note: art px, origin = mouth tip (top centre of lip ring), +y toward the base, upright

vermouth.origin_note: art px, origin = mouth tip (top centre of lip ring), +y toward the base, upright
